name: Roland RD-800
description: Roland RD-800 stage piano: the temporary Live Set (common, song/rhythm, delay, reverb, and for each of the four layers UPPER 1-3 and LOWER its internal layer, external layer, Modulation FX and Tremolo/Amp Simulator) and the system blocks (common, compressor, V-Link, switch assign), from the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: RD-800 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Jan. 1, 2014)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from RD-800_MIDI_Imple_e02_W.pdf (sha256 7597c4d14d50d68e4aa6db73a023e0e4852be36e901f058d024143bd6779a24e). Model ID 00 00 75, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Layers are filed under the manual's names: upper1, upper2, upper3 and lower, each with .internal (Live Set Internal Layer), .external (Live Set External Layer), .modFx (Live Set Modulation FX) and .tremoloAmp (Live Set Tremolo/Amp Simulator). The Modulation FX and the Tremolo/Amp Simulator are laid out from the one table the manual prints for both (p11).

Live Set Common 00 63-00 7E (p11) is a group the manual opens with a rule and Sympathetic Resonance Switch and does not otherwise head: Depth, Damper, Pre LPF … Level, Damper Offset … Damper Min Pkg. Their ids are the printed names (liveSet.depth, liveSet.damper, liveSet.level), which in this block mean the resonance's, not the live set's.

The Internal Layer table (p12) prints "Tone Program Change" twice, at 00 1F and at 00 22, either side of Tone Bank Select MSB and LSB; the RD-2000's table has only the one at 00 22. Both are laid out, numbered in printed order (toneProgramChange1 at 00 1F, toneProgramChange2 at 00 22); which the instrument means by 00 1F the page does not say.

The worked RQ1 (p15) prints F0 41 10 00 00 75 10 00 00 00 00 00 00 7F 71 F7 for Live Set Common: the address, size and checksum are this profile's requestLiveSet, but the 11H command byte is missing from both the diagram and the summary line.
The worked examples call the Live Set's delay address "the address of DELAY TYPE of Setup" (p15); there is no Setup block in this map.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the front panel and the external layers transmit (Control Change, p6-7) is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: Delay, Reverb, Modulation FX and Tremolo/Amp Simulator parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.presets: none: the MIDI Implementation prints no Bank Select table for live sets or programs, only the generic Bank Select and Program Change messages ("1. Receive data", p1-3), so no bank list is claimed
coverage.memories: not in the map: the MIDI Implementation prints only the system and the temporary area; stored live sets/programs have no addresses there
coverage.switchAssign: System Switch Assign's Live Set Switch C-I Variation Number (00 00 03 20 - 00 00 03 26) are not laid out: the manual prints A, B, ":" and J (p9-10), and an elided run is filled in only where its names are numbered; A, B and J are here
